name: cluster-monitor
description: Read-only Slurm dashboard: cluster load, job priority breakdown and job status.

clusterMonitor.refreshSeconds.description: Polling interval. Keep it >= 30 to be gentle on the Slurm controller.

clusterMonitor.partitions.description: Partitions to show. Empty = all partitions.

clusterMonitor.recentHours.description: How far back to list finished jobs.
